variants.headline: Party leader faces a public scandal
variants.body: A scandal concerning a party leader has come to light in {colony}. Give {target} a fair hearing; outrage alone should not be allowed to write the whole verdict.

variants.headline: Leadership under an unwelcome spotlight
variants.body: A party leader is the subject of a newly revealed scandal. Give {target} a fair hearing; outrage alone should not be allowed to write the whole verdict.

variants.headline: A scandal tests political trust
variants.body: A scandal about a party leader has become public in the colony. Give {target} a fair hearing; outrage alone should not be allowed to write the whole verdict.
